underlying_goal: Fix white pixel artifacts appearing on all edges of video thumbnails in a web project
friction_detail: First fix only addressed the iframe overlay inset but the artifact was actually a subpixel rendering issue on the thumbnail container's border-radius, requiring a second iteration with an inset box-shadow approach.
brief_summary: User wanted to fix white pixel artifacts on video thumbnail edges; after an initial incomplete fix, Claude correctly diagnosed a subpixel border-radius rendering issue and resolved it with an inset box-shadow, then deployed successfully.
